description: This file handles the creation and output of PDF invoices in the vtiger CRM system. It initializes a PDF controller, loads invoice data, and outputs the resulting PDF either to a file or directly to the browser for download.

classes.name: Vtiger_InvoicePDFController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for generating invoice PDFs in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: loadRecord
methods.description: Loads invoice record data for PDF generation.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Outputs the generated PDF either as a file or for download.
